egin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch7:7-3Show that the curvature tensor of a Riemannian locally symmetric space is parallel: $ abla ext{Rm} = 0$. (Used on pp. 297, 351.) \end{exercise}

Proof

\sketch At each point $p$, the local geodesic symmetry is an isometry fixing $p$ with differential $-\operatorname {Id}$. It preserves $ abla \operatorname {Rm}$ by local-isometry invariance, while its differential acts by $-1$ on this covariant $5$-tensor. Hence $( abla \operatorname {Rm})_p=0$.
